fidelity_notes: Four QPs30/35/40/45 explicitly requested by user.
One representative published backbone family per original task; Torchvision image/AR adapters differ from original OpenMMLab implementations.
Full mode evaluates all available original validation sources with resumable per-source caches; pilot mode is a declared subset.
Official released image NPP used; source conditioning uses loss-lambda/8 rather than raw QP.
Proxy is CompressAI Minnen2018 pretrained implementation, independently calibrated to actual BPG reconstructions.
400k proxy updates are global across four QP-specific proxies; paper does not disambiguate per-proxy accounting.
Image proxy/task lambda values at new QPs are log-linearly interpolated/extrapolated from published tables.
Released image NPP for all tasks; frozen offline per-frame SAM2 masks.
MSE warm-up and fidelity gates precede short task training; no identity fallback.
Training-only STE clipping preserves clipped forward values; task coefficient0.1, beta5 are declared trials.
Tracking uses framewise Minnen proxy recalibrated to H264, not an exact motion-aware codec model.
Codec-specific proxy refit; exact shared warm-up/proxy/RNG per paired worker.
Each COCO image is one independent H264/H265 stream; include all stream headers; no inter-frame claim.
Full deployment geometry decoder-only reconstruction refit; frozen analysis/entropy.
Disjoint TRAIN-dev paired rate/reconstruction/direction screen before NPP task updates.
Residual-bounded NPP (y = clip(x + 0.25*tanh(delta))) with small non-zero output init; >45 dB initial PSNR.
Stricter fidelity gates: 32 dB warm-up gate and 24 dB task collapse gate.
Three arms isolate SAM interior then SAM instance boundary; no GT edge extraction.
Separate rounded/relaxed positive-power rate heads with checkpoint-persistent mode flag.
Gaussian 0.5/0.8 baselines share 64 VAL sources and actual-codec AP protocol.
